notes.title: Patch v0.0.12
notes.notes:
Features
- Combiner: A new feature in the blacksmith allows merging multiple similar equipment items to increase rarity all the way up to Legendary
- Skills can now level up with Orbs of Power after being used enough times

Fixes
- Level 0 heroes would appear in the Tavern early in the game
- Effects such as talents that granted stats would not work
- Ctrl+R is now disabled

notes.title: Patch v0.0.7
notes.notes:
Features
- Added an "Experience bonus" modifier
- Added Tavern leveling system by decorating with gems to improve hero attraction speed
- Show "per minute" on journey loot stats in journeys window
- Added auto-dismiss tavern hero unlock in Automagus
- Added a 25% experience bonus on map victory

Fixes
- Minor alignment issue in loading screen
